name: skills
description: Generic skills, agents and mods for Claude Code

plugins.name: builder
plugins.description: Watches the pull request an /implement session is working on, shows its state and its agents, and wakes the session when the pull request changes

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: Shows a parent session every /implement sub session at a glance, in a band above the prompt and a pane, and opens a sub session beside the parent when its issue is pressed
